name: ReleaseGuard
tagline: One release-readiness gate for game builds.
description: ReleaseGuard combines trusted game-authored scenarios with packaged-build review. Test interrupted save writes, verify recovery behavior, collect logs, enforce step-duration budgets, and fail CI on size growth or development leftovers, without a hosted service.
requirements: A packaged game build; scenarios optional
before: Windows 10/11 x64, or Python 3.10+ on Linux
A packaged game build to scan
Game-authored scenarios if you want save, stability, or timing checks

steps.title: Get the app
steps.text: Windows: download the win64 zip and extract it. Linux: use the zip or wheel with Python 3.10+.

steps.title: Point it at a build
steps.text: On Windows, double-click ReleaseGuard.exe and paste the build folder. Or run release-check from any terminal.

steps.title: Review the result
steps.text: Reports land in ReleaseGuard-results. Add a scenario manifest for save, stability, or timing checks.

faq.a: Yes. The alpha is free for evaluation and internal use.

faq.q: Does the Windows app need Python?
faq.a: No. The win64 zip contains a self-contained ReleaseGuard.exe. The Linux archive still uses Python 3.10 or newer.

faq.q: Why does Windows warn about the app?
faq.a: The alpha executable is unsigned. Verify the SHA-256 on this page, then choose More info and Run anyway.

faq.q: Does it need a hosted service or account?
faq.a: No. It runs entirely on your machine or CI and sends no telemetry.

faq.q: Does it test my real saves?
faq.a: The bundled examples are synthetic. Real games need a small adapter and their own scenario manifest.

limits: This is an early alpha, not a drop-in engine plugin.
Save checks need a game-specific adapter; the bundled examples are synthetic.
Stability and timing checks are test hooks and budgets, not crash diagnosis or profiling.
Packaged-build review does not modify or optimize the build.

scoop.label: Scoop (Windows)
scoop.command: scoop bucket add brlinkin https://github.com/Shadoww23/scoop-brlinkin; scoop install brlinkin/releaseguard
scoop.note: Portable Windows app installed from the official release ZIP.

aur.label: Arch / AUR
aur.note: Recipe is prepared but not published yet. It will verify and install the official archive, not mirror it.

pipx.label: pipx (wheel)
pipx.note: Installs your own published wheel, not a third-party mirror.

itch.label: itch.io (Linux + Windows)
itch.note: Direct download from the Brlinkin page.

checks: Test whether an interrupted save write corrupts progress.
Gate releases on save, stability, timing, and packaging checks.
Detect oversized builds, duplicates, and shipped dev files.
Run on Windows and Linux with Python 3.10+.

problems_cards.title: How do I test whether an interrupted save write corrupts a save?
problems_cards.text: Run a disposable scenario that interrupts a write and checks recovery.

problems_cards.title: How do I add a game save-integrity check to CI?
problems_cards.text: Use release-check with your own trusted manifest and exit codes.

problems_cards.title: How do I catch oversized builds and shipped dev files?
problems_cards.text: Inventory a packaged build, compare a baseline, and flag review candidates.
